## Invitations

A total of 705 invitations were issued. Attendance was 119, representing a rate of 16.9 per cent. The figures provide a straightforward view of response to the outreach activity and should be considered alongside the arrangements used to contact invitees.

The invitation process included SMS contact for 605 invitations. This provided an additional direct channel for communicating the invitation and supporting attendance. No reminder messages were recorded: the reminder figure was 0.

Van days were maintained where road conditions allowed. This enabled outreach activity to continue in areas accessible by road, while recognising the practical limits affecting travel and service delivery. The arrangements were applied as conditions permitted.

## Contact

Contact activity therefore consisted of the original invitations, SMS messages, and any available reminder provision. The recorded results are 705 invited, 119 attended, 16.9 per cent attendance, 605 contacted by SMS, and 0 receiving a reminder.
